note: An attacker-controlled XSLT variable or parameter body is rendered into a temporary result tree fragment (RVT).
Any RVTs reachable from the variable result are marked GLOBAL so they survive beyond the variable scope.

note: The ownership flag is updated on the RVT document, making it eligible for later persistence instead of immediate free.
When the variable scope ends, GLOBAL RVTs are moved into the persistent RVT list rather than being destroyed.

code: RVT->psvi = XSLT_RVT_GLOBAL; RVT->next = (xmlNodePtr) ctxt->persistRVT; ctxt->persistRVT = RVT;
note: The RVT is linked into ctxt->persistRVT, extending its lifetime until stylesheet teardown.
During stylesheet destruction, the stylesheet document is freed after its dependent structures have already been torn down.
